achieves: Early bounded advisory feedback on at most hot_set_max restackable integ stations without turning local output into merge authority.
origin: 16-lens northstar R9 (northstar-daemon-hotset); ADR-0711 A-2 OVERRULE and ADR-0716 establish Cargo as the protected executor while preserving bounded local work.

rule.main_checkout: orchestrator + optional check-daemon allowed; remains a possible warm Buck2 home but carries no merge authority
rule.worker_lanes: Workers MAY run scoped Cargo merge-path checks and optional Buck2 hermeticity checks in their isolated worktrees
rule.builder: Optional bounded Buck2 local-hermeticity fan-out; Cargo workspace evidence remains required by ADR-0716
rule.station_env: SWARM_CANDIDATE_ROOT=<abs path to .worktrees/integ-*> selects the station tree
rule.cap_enforcement: check-daemon-hotset REFUSEs when station count > hot_set_max

allowed: rust-analyzer / IDE LSP read-only diagnostics in any worktree
forbidden: treating LSP diagnostics as merge authority
equating editor or local diagnostics with oya-ci-required
presenting check-daemon output as reviewer approval
lsp_carve_out.note: LSP read-only, local Cargo, Buck2, and daemon observations remain distinct from protected merge authority.

ensure: ci/process-kit lib refuses SWARM_BLESSED_PUSH inherit + GIT_REAL retarget
ci/process-kit git_shim refuses no-verify while worker Cargo checks remain allowed
cargo test --workspace is protected-path evidence; buck2 test //ci/process-kit:oya-process-kit-unittest is optional local hermeticity
integ/build workspace membership before claiming live hot-set
overturn_when: ADR-0716 protected executor or the optional daemon topology changes
founder authorizes a different warm-daemon topology
